title: Genesis 24:14-16: the servant's prayer and Rebekah comes out with her jar
summary: Genesis 24:14-16 in English: the servant's prayer that the girl who offers water to him and his camels be the one appointed for Isaac, and Rebekah coming out with her jar, a beautiful virgin. The servant's own words (I, I, I, my, he) are highlighted in gold, 'camels' is underlined, 'Your' and 'Isaac' are red and 'Abraham' is blue.

text.text: 14 now may it be that the girl to whom I say, ‘Please let down your jar so that I may drink,’ and who answers, ‘Drink, and I will water your camels also’ —may she be the one whom You have appointed for Your servant Isaac; and by this I will know that You have shown lovingkindness to my master.”
15 Before he had finished speaking, behold, Rebekah who was born to Bethuel the son of Milcah, the wife of Abraham’s brother Nahor, came out with her jar on her shoulder.
16 The girl was very beautiful, a virgin, and no man had had relations with her; and she went down to the spring and filled her jar and came up.
